home.headline: From idea to launch.
home.sub: A team in Amman that builds websites, apps and AI tools, and tests them for security before they go live. You can follow every step of your project in your own client portal.

services.title: What we can build for you
services.intro: One team covers all of it. Whichever you start with, it follows the same ten stages, and you follow it in your portal. Here's what each one is and what it includes.

S1.name: Web platforms
S1.description: Company websites and online stores your team can update themselves, that load fast even on a weak connection.

S2.name: Software
S2.description: Custom software built around how you work: dashboards, internal tools and customer portals, with user roles and a record of who changed what.

S3.name: Mobile apps
S3.description: iPhone and Android apps, published to the stores and kept up to date after launch.

S4.name: AI solutions
S4.description: AI that reads your documents, answers questions about them and shows where each answer came from.

S5.name: Data & analytics
S5.description: We pull your numbers into one place and build reports you can trust.

S6.name: Security assessments
S6.description: We test your systems the way an attacker would, then give you a clear list of what to fix first.

S7.name: Security operations
S7.description: Round-the-clock monitoring, and a team that responds when something looks wrong.

S8.name: Cloud & DevOps
S8.description: Moving to the cloud, automatic deployments and servers set up as code, so releases become routine.

S9.name: Integration
S9.description: We connect the systems you already use so data moves between them on its own.

S10.name: Managed support
S10.description: After launch we stay on, with fixes, updates and support under an agreed response time.

S11.name: ERP systems
S11.description: One system for your accounts, inventory, sales, purchasing and people, set up around how your company actually runs.

about.title: We build software that holds up
about.body: NULL is a software and security company in Amman. We design and build websites, custom software, apps, ERP systems and AI tools, and we test every one for security before it goes live.

facts.label: service lines, all from one team

principles.title: You always know where it stands
principles.body: Every project moves through the same ten stages. Your portal shows which one you're in, what's done and what's next, without a single follow-up call.

principles.title: Security from the first line
principles.body: Security isn't a phase we bolt on at the end. It's in how we design, write and review, and every build is tested before launch.

principles.title: Made for Arabic and English
principles.body: Right-to-left is never an afterthought. We design every screen to work properly in Arabic and English from day one.

principles.title: We stay after launch
principles.body: Launch is a stage, not the end. We keep your system updated, secure and running, with agreed response times.

login.title: Client portal
login.intro: Enter the access code we sent you to open your project: progress, invoices, files and requests.
login.accessCodeHint: It starts with NS- and came from NULL with your project.
login.incomplete: The code has 16 characters after NS-. Check you have all of it.
login.badCode: That code didn't open a project. Check it and try again.
login.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
login.keepSafe: Anyone with this code can see your project, so keep it like a password. Lost it? Ask us for a new one and the old one stops working.

admin.title: Admin
admin.name: Name
admin.subtitle: Set up clients and their projects. Everything you do here shows up in the client's portal straight away.
admin.failed: That didn't save. Check the fields and try again.
admin.codeActive: The client can get in. Current code created {date}.
admin.codeNone: No working code. The client can't open this project until you create one.
admin.codeOnce: Here's the client's access code. It's shown this once, so copy it now. We only keep a scrambled copy.
admin.codeHandover: Send it straight to the client. If it's ever lost or shared, replace it and the old code stops working at once.
admin.confirmReplace: Replace the code? The current one stops working straight away and anyone using it is signed out.
admin.confirmRevoke: Turn off access? The client is signed out and can't get in until you create a new code.
admin.codeFailed: The project was created, but its code wasn't. Open the project and create one there.
admin.progressHint: The client sees this percentage on their page, and gets a notification when it changes.
admin.paymentsHint: Add each payment below. When the client pays one, record it and their page updates.
